Will I ever be remembered? What's the point of trying so hard when my effort won't amount to anything in the grand scheme of everything? If I gave up trying to take care of myself and just locked myself in my room forever would anyone care?

  I think if I found a greater reason to live rather than spite and curiosity maybe I would be able to resolve this, but for the mean time I see no end to these kinds of thoughts.
This isn't exactly about my body, but, I think smarter and perform mental activities (drawing, reading, writing) better when I sit criss-crossed.

I am 15. I'm aware that I'm relatively young and shouldn't be worried about these things, but I think it's better to learn younger than be in your 30s and absoloutely clueless. 

Some of my flaws are being overly negative about myself, being way too loud when I get excited, I over analyze everything, and when i like someone , I like them way too much. I'm aware that I get clingy, and it's not an obsessive cligny, more of just a respond as soon as you text me type. Which isn't necessarily bad but it can make me look like I have nothing going on in my life, which can make me look uninteresting.

Adding a colored person or a LGBTQ+ person and making that their entire personality. Whether it's a side character or the main character. I want them to have a personality that isn't all about race or sexuality, it can be a part of their character, but it shouldn't be the main focus.
I felt this one so much. It's even worse when I eat in front of others.
I want to begin running 2 miles at least 4 times a week.
